title: Bird vs Spear Witch
description: A furious pink-haired girl with glowing eyes wields a large purple spear and a war hammer while confronting a large angry yellow bird covered in purple spots. The bird is surrounded by exploding wind chimes, broken metal tubes, and colorful petals against a dark background.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy scene showing an angry pink-haired girl with glowing eyes and dark clothing wielding a massive purple spear and war hammer, fiercely confronting a large furious yellow cartoon bird covered in purple spots. The bird is exploding through a collection of shattered metal wind chimes and hanging tubes, with colorful petals and fragments flying everywhere. Stone path with vibrant flowers at the bottom, dark moody background, high contrast cartoon illustration style.
